name: shuttercontrol-rev2
comment: Outline and mounting holes as board-3E2 (see board-3E2_board_spec.json). 4 copper layers for JLCPCB standard 4-layer 1.6 mm (JLC04161H-7628: 7628 prepreg ~0.21 mm, core ~1.065 mm); In1.Cu = GND plane, In2.Cu = V3R3 plane. Edge clearance 0.3 mm (JLCPCB routed edge min 0.2 mm).
